hypothesis: a distinct nonnegative base-return term that adds bounded second-pass layer exposure is more physically faithful than representing backing reflection only as an energy-conserving redistribution of the incident layer exposure

evidence_basis.source: Kodak VISION Color Print Film 2383/3383 technical information
evidence_basis.fact: an antihalation layer under the emulsion absorbs light reflected from support surfaces and reduces colour fringing around bright features
the anti-halation undercoat is a separate beneath-emulsion structure whose density is removed in processing
halation is caused by light reflected from the support back into light-sensitive material; absorbing backing reduces that return

required_controls: negative, nonfinite, over-unity and excess-column-coupling profile rejection
allowed_actions: implement one isolated float64 full-frame reference
evaluate only frozen synthetic impulse, edge, scale and identity witnesses
repair implementation defects without changing the physical hypothesis or gates
forbidden_actions: fit return fractions or radii to photographs
call the generic profile Cinestill, Vision3 or any named stock
reuse display-RGB screen blend as the reference
change U6.P1A, U6.P3A, U6.P3C or any completed gate
render product photographs before the synthetic reference passes
claim stock, process, camera, pressure-plate or anti-halation calibration

branch_rule.pass: retain a generic backing-return reference and freeze a separately versioned Standard compiler/photographic severe-stress challenger
branch_rule.fail: close the additive-return representation or repair a demonstrated implementation defect; preserve U6.P1A/P3A

claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired float64 reference for bounded backing-reflection second-pass exposure; no measured film, named stock, process, camera, pressure-plate, scanner, calibration, authenticity, preference or product claim
